<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def blocks_map(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pts = {}
    for r in range(len(rows)):
        for c in range(len(rows[r])):
            ch = rows[r][c]
            if ch in 'wSbYpg': pts[(r,c)] = ch
    out = {}; used = set()
    for (r,c),ch in sorted(pts.items()):
        if (r,c) in used: continue
        if (r+1,c) in pts and (r,c+1) in pts and (r+1,c+1) in pts and pts[(r+1,c)]==ch and pts[(r,c+1)]==ch and pts[(r+1,c+1)]==ch:
            out[(r,c)] = ch
            for dr in (0,1):
                for dc in (0,1): used.add((r+dr,c+dc))
    return out
b0 = blocks_map(current_frame)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':17,'col':20}], intent='explore')
b1 = blocks_map(current_frame)
print('TOP RED diff:')
for k in sorted(set(b0)|set(b1)):
    if b0.get(k)!=b1.get(k): print(' ', k, b0.get(k,'-'),'->',b1.get(k,'-'))

    out = {}; used = set()
    for (r,c),ch in sorted(pts.items()):
